moments.title: Halloween Weekend
moments.blurb: The spookiest night of the year falls on Sunday, bringing a weekend of fancy dress parties and trick-or-treating across the UK.

angles.name: Spooky Celebrations
angles.copy: Who's ready for a weekend of ghoulish fun? Halloween is officially on Sunday, so get those costumes ready! What's your favourite Halloween track?

angles.name: Trick or Treat Prep
angles.copy: Don't forget to stock up on sweets! Halloween is just around the corner. Are you going all out with decorations this year?

moments.title: Bonfire Night
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night, or Bonfire Night, is celebrated across the UK with fireworks displays and bonfires on November 5th.

angles.name: Fireworks & Bonfires
angles.copy: Remember, remember the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is next Friday. Where are you heading for fireworks this year?

angles.name: Autumn Traditions
angles.copy: Wrap up warm! Bonfire Night traditions are almost upon us. What's your favourite thing about Guy Fawkes Night?

moments.title: Premier League Weekend
moments.blurb: Key Premier League clashes this weekend include Chelsea vs Man Utd, Man City vs Brighton on Saturday, and Liverpool vs Arsenal on Sunday.

angles.name: Big Games Ahead
angles.copy: Massive Premier League weekend coming up! Chelsea face Man Utd and Liverpool take on Arsenal. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Saturday Showdowns
angles.copy: It's a big Saturday in the Premier League with Chelsea vs Man Utd and Man City vs Brighton. Predictions?

moments.title: Champions League Matchday 4
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League continues with Matchday 4 on November 3rd and 4th, featuring major fixtures including Man Utd vs Roma and Fenerbahçe vs Liverpool.

angles.name: Midweek European Action
angles.copy: Champions League action returns next week! Man Utd host Roma, and Liverpool travel to Fenerbahçe. Who's making it through?

angles.name: UCL Matchday 4
angles.copy: Get ready for another round of UEFA Champions League fixtures next Tuesday and Wednesday. Which game are you most excited for?

moments.title: Autumn Nations Series Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Autumn Nations Series of Rugby Union begins next week with Ireland v Argentina on Nov 6, Scotland v New Zealand on Nov 7, and Wales v Japan also on Nov 7.

angles.name: Rugby Returns
angles.copy: The Autumn Nations Series is here! Ireland, Scotland, and Wales are all in action next week. Who are you supporting?

angles.name: Wales v Japan
angles.copy: Wales take on Japan at the Principality Stadium next Saturday! Get ready to cheer on the boys in red. C'mon Cymru!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Continues
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off 2026 series is ongoing, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood in the tent.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: It's another week in the Bake Off tent! Who's your favourite baker to win this year? And how are we feeling about Nigella as a judge?

angles.name: Technical Challenge
angles.copy: Soggy bottoms or showstopper? The Great British Bake Off continues tonight. What's been your favourite challenge so far?

moments.title: Happy 52nd Birthday, Nelly
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper Nelly, known for hits like 'Hot in Herre' and 'Dilemma', turns 52 on November 2nd. He was born in 1974.

angles.name: Nelly's Birthday
angles.copy: It's Nelly's 52nd birthday on November 2nd! What's your favourite track from the 'Hot in Herre' hitmaker?

angles.name: Throwback Nelly
angles.copy: Celebrating Nelly's birthday next week! Still got 'Dilemma' on repeat? Let us know your top Nelly tune!

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday, Bryan Adams
moments.blurb: Canadian rock icon Bryan Adams, famous for 'Summer of 69' and '(Everything I Do) I Do It for You', celebrates his 67th birthday on November 5th. He was born in 1959.

angles.name: Bryan Adams Rocks 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary Bryan Adams on November 5th! What's your ultimate Bryan Adams power ballad?

angles.name: Summer of '69 Forever
angles.copy: It's Bryan Adams' birthday next week! Still cranking 'Summer of 69'? Tell us your favourite memory associated with his music.

moments.title: Happy 30th Birthday, Lorde
moments.blurb: New Zealand singer-songwriter Lorde, known for her breakout hit 'Royals', turns 30 on November 7th. She was born in 1996.

angles.name: Lorde Turns 30
angles.copy: Can you believe Lorde turns 30 next week? 'Royals' feels like yesterday! What's your favourite track from her?

angles.name: Celebrating Lorde
angles.copy: Happy 30th to Lorde on November 7th! Which of her albums is your go-to?

moments.title: Manic Street Preachers & Suede in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Welsh rock legends Manic Street Preachers co-headline with Suede at Utilita Arena Cardiff on November 4th.

angles.name: Welsh Icons Live
angles.copy: Manic Street Preachers and Suede are live in Cardiff next Wednesday! Who's got tickets to see these legends?

angles.name: Gig of the Week
angles.copy: Two iconic bands, one stage! Manic Street Preachers and Suede hit Cardiff's Utilita Arena on Nov 4th. What's your ultimate track from either band?

moments.title: Paul Heaton in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Paul Heaton, known for The Housemartins and The Beautiful South, plays Utilita Arena Cardiff on November 2nd.

angles.name: Heaton Live in Cardiff
angles.copy: Paul Heaton is bringing his incredible back catalogue to Utilita Arena Cardiff next Monday! Who's excited?

angles.name: Legendary Songwriter
angles.copy: From The Housemartins to The Beautiful South, Paul Heaton is a true legend. Catch him live in Cardiff on Nov 2nd!

moments.title: Huey Morgan in Exeter

angles.name: Fun Lovin' Criminals Icon
angles.copy: Catch the legendary Huey Morgan performing live tonight! If you're in Exeter, get to Exeter Phoenix!

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday, Sean 'Diddy' Combs

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: A true force in music, Diddy turns 57 next week! From Bad Boy Records to global hits, what's his most iconic moment for you?

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Joni Mitchell
moments.blurb: Iconic Canadian singer-songwriter Joni Mitchell, celebrated for her poetic lyrics and unique musical style, turns 83 on November 7th. She was born in 1943.

angles.name: Joni at 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the incomparable Joni Mitchell on November 7th! What's the Joni song that speaks to you most?

angles.name: Legendary Songwriter
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring artistry of Joni Mitchell next week! Her influence is immeasurable. What's your favourite album?

moments.title: The Proclaimers in Swansea

angles.copy: Get ready for a night of anthems! The Proclaimers are in Swansea next week. What's your favourite singalong track?
